//go:build windows && rfs_mapping_startup_diagnostic

package main

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"debug/pe"
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/binary"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"
	"unicode/utf16"

	"golang.org/x/sys/windows"
)

type mappingStartupConfig struct {
	Format                     int             `json:"format"`
	RunID                      string          `json:"run_id"`
	SourceSHA                  string          `json:"source_sha"`
	FixtureNonce               string          `json:"fixture_nonce"`
	PriorEvidenceDirectory     string          `json:"prior_evidence_directory"`
	EvidenceDirectory          string          `json:"evidence_directory"`
	NativeEvidenceDirectory    string          `json:"native_evidence_directory"`
	OwnerSID                   string          `json:"owner_sid"`
	InitialInventoryError      string          `json:"initial_inventory_error"`
	InitialInventoryDiagnostic json.RawMessage `json:"initial_inventory_diagnostic"`
	initial                    mappingCommandDiagnostic
}

type mappingStartupCellReceipt struct {
	Name                            string                            `json:"name"`
	Kind                            mappingStartupKind                `json:"kind"`
	Ordinal                         int                               `json:"ordinal"`
	PriorDiagnosticProcessCreations int                               `json:"prior_diagnostic_process_creations"`
	Status                          string                            `json:"status"`
	Error                           string                            `json:"error"`
	ErrorTruncated                  bool                              `json:"error_truncated"`
	Diagnostic                      mappingCommandDiagnostic          `json:"diagnostic"`
	ParentEnvironment               []mappingStartupEnvironment       `json:"parent_environment,omitempty"`
	ChildEnvironment                []mappingStartupEnvironment       `json:"child_environment,omitempty"`
	UtilityPreparation              *mappingStartupUtilityPreparation `json:"utility_preparation,omitempty"`
}

type mappingStartupUtilityPreparation struct {
	Path             string `json:"path"`
	Size             *int64 `json:"size,omitempty"`
	ReadBytes        int    `json:"read_bytes"`
	SHA256           string `json:"sha256"`
	ElapsedNanos     int64  `json:"elapsed_ns"`
	CleanupConfirmed bool   `json:"cleanup_confirmed"`
}

type mappingStartupUtilityFile interface {
	io.Reader
	Stat() (os.FileInfo, error)
	Close() error
}

type mappingStartupUtilityOps struct {
	CheckPath   func(string) error
	Open        func(string) (mappingStartupUtilityFile, error)
	CommandLine func([]string) string
}

func prepareMappingStartupUtility(ctx context.Context, moduleRoot, executable string, ops mappingStartupUtilityOps) (script string, facts mappingStartupUtilityPreparation, resultErr error) {
	started := time.Now()
	facts.Path = filepath.Join(moduleRoot, "Microsoft.PowerShell.Utility", "Microsoft.PowerShell.Utility.psd1")
	facts.CleanupConfirmed = true
	defer func() { facts.ElapsedNanos = time.Since(started).Nanoseconds() }()
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return "", facts, err
	}
	if !filepath.IsAbs(facts.Path) || strings.HasPrefix(facts.Path, `\\`) {
		return "", facts, errors.New("Utility manifest must have an absolute local path")
	}
	if err := ops.CheckPath(facts.Path); err != nil {
		return "", facts, errors.Join(err, ctx.Err())
	}
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return "", facts, err
	}
	file, err := ops.Open(facts.Path)
	if file != nil {
		facts.CleanupConfirmed = false
		defer func() {
			closeErr := file.Close()
			facts.CleanupConfirmed = closeErr == nil
			resultErr = errors.Join(resultErr, closeErr, ctx.Err())
			if resultErr != nil {
				script = ""
			}
		}()
	}
	if err != nil {
		return "", facts, errors.Join(err, ctx.Err())
	}
	if file == nil {
		return "", facts, errors.New("Utility manifest open returned no file")
	}
	before, err := file.Stat()
	if err != nil {
		return "", facts, errors.Join(err, ctx.Err())
	}
	size := before.Size()
	facts.Size = &size
	if !before.Mode().IsRegular() || size < 0 || size > mappingByteLimit {
		return "", facts, errors.New("Utility manifest is not a bounded regular file")
	}
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return "", facts, err
	}
	data, readErr := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(file, mappingByteLimit+1))
	facts.ReadBytes = len(data)
	if len(data) > mappingByteLimit {
		readErr = errors.Join(readErr, errors.New("Utility manifest exceeds 1 MiB"))
	}
	if readErr != nil {
		return "", facts, errors.Join(readErr, ctx.Err())
	}
	after, err := file.Stat()
	if err != nil {
		return "", facts, errors.Join(err, ctx.Err())
	}
	if int64(len(data)) != size || size != after.Size() || before.ModTime() != after.ModTime() {
		return "", facts, errors.New("Utility manifest changed during inspection")
	}
	facts.SHA256 = fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256(data))
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return "", facts, err
	}
	script, err = mappingStartupImportScript(facts.Path)
	if err != nil {
		return "", facts, err
	}
	words := utf16.Encode([]rune(script))
	encoded := make([]byte, len(words)*2)
	for index, word := range words {
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(encoded[index*2:], word)
	}
	args := []string{executable, "-NoLogo", "-NoProfile", "-NonInteractive", "-ExecutionPolicy", "Bypass", "-EncodedCommand", base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(encoded)}
	commandLine := ops.CommandLine(args)
	if strings.IndexByte(commandLine, 0) >= 0 || len(utf16.Encode([]rune(commandLine)))+1 > 32767 {
		return "", facts, errors.New("Utility diagnostic command line exceeds Windows limit")
	}
	return script, facts, ctx.Err()
}

func prepareMappingStartupCell(ctx context.Context, cell mappingStartupCell, moduleRoot, executable string, ops mappingStartupUtilityOps) (mappingStartupCell, *mappingStartupUtilityPreparation, error) {
	if cell.Kind != mappingStartupImport {
		return cell, nil, nil
	}
	if cell.Script != "" {
		return cell, nil, errors.New("Utility diagnostic script was prepared before its cell")
	}
	script, facts, err := prepareMappingStartupUtility(ctx, moduleRoot, executable, ops)
	cell.Script = script
	return cell, &facts, err
}

type mappingStartupEnvironmentValue struct {
	ObservedBytes int    `json:"observed_bytes"`
	SHA256        string `json:"sha256"`
	PrefixBase64  string `json:"prefix_base64"`
	Truncated     bool   `json:"truncated"`
}

type mappingStartupEnvironment struct {
	Name    string                          `json:"name"`
	Present bool                            `json:"present"`
	Value   *mappingStartupEnvironmentValue `json:"value,omitempty"`
}

func observeMappingStartupEnvironment(lookup func(string) (string, bool)) []mappingStartupEnvironment {
	result := make([]mappingStartupEnvironment, 0, 3)
	for _, name := range [...]string{"PSModulePath", "WinPSModulePath", "PSModuleAnalysisCachePath"} {
		value, present := lookup(name)
		entry := mappingStartupEnvironment{Name: name, Present: present}
		if present {
			data := []byte(value)
			entry.Value = &mappingStartupEnvironmentValue{
				ObservedBytes: len(data), SHA256: fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256(data)),
				PrefixBase64: base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(data[:min(len(data), 4096)]), Truncated: len(data) > 4096,
			}
		}
		result = append(result, entry)
	}
	return result
}

type mappingStartupObservedPlatform struct {
	delegate          platform
	lookup            func(string) (string, bool)
	parentEnvironment []mappingStartupEnvironment
	childEnvironment  []mappingStartupEnvironment
}

func (p *mappingStartupObservedPlatform) Preflight() (map[string]any, error) {
	return p.delegate.Preflight()
}
func (p *mappingStartupObservedPlatform) StartWithEnvironment(executable string, args []string, directory string, environment []string) (child, error) {
	p.parentEnvironment = observeMappingStartupEnvironment(p.lookup)
	p.childEnvironment = observeMappingStartupEnvironment(func(name string) (string, bool) { return mappingEnvironmentLookup(environment, name) })
	return p.delegate.StartWithEnvironment(executable, args, directory, environment)
}

type mappingStartupImageReceipt struct {
	Path    string `json:"path"`
	Size    int64  `json:"size"`
	SHA256  string `json:"sha256"`
	Machine uint16 `json:"pe_machine"`
	Error   string `json:"error"`
}

type mappingStartupReceipt struct {
	Format                     int                          `json:"format"`
	RunID                      string                       `json:"run_id"`
	SourceSHA                  string                       `json:"source_sha"`
	FixtureNonce               string                       `json:"fixture_nonce"`
	Status                     string                       `json:"status"`
	Aborted                    bool                         `json:"aborted"`
	CleanupConfirmed           bool                         `json:"cleanup_confirmed"`
	TimingContext              string                       `json:"timing_context"`
	ImageFactsContext          string                       `json:"image_facts_context"`
	EnvironmentFactsContext    string                       `json:"environment_facts_context"`
	PriorEvidenceDirectory     string                       `json:"prior_evidence_directory"`
	InitialInventoryError      string                       `json:"initial_inventory_error"`
	InitialInventoryDiagnostic json.RawMessage              `json:"initial_inventory_diagnostic"`
	OriginalInputObserved      bool                         `json:"original_input_observed"`
	OriginalScriptObserved     bool                         `json:"original_script_observed"`
	DiagnosticInventoryIntent  *mappingStartupIntent        `json:"diagnostic_inventory_intent,omitempty"`
	Cells                      []mappingStartupCellReceipt  `json:"cells"`
	Images                     []mappingStartupImageReceipt `json:"images"`
}

type mappingStartupIntent struct {
	InputBytes       int    `json:"input_bytes"`
	InputSHA256      string `json:"input_sha256"`
	ScriptUTF16Units int    `json:"script_utf16_units"`
	ScriptSHA256     string `json:"script_utf16le_sha256"`
}

func mappingStartupRequired(fields map[string]json.RawMessage, name string, target any) error {
	raw, present := fields[name]
	if !present || strings.TrimSpace(string(raw)) == "null" {
		return fmt.Errorf("inventory diagnostic omitted %s", name)
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, target); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("invalid inventory diagnostic %s: %w", name, err)
	}
	return nil
}

func validateMappingStartupCapture(raw json.RawMessage) (mappingStreamDiagnostic, error) {
	var stream mappingStreamDiagnostic
	if err := decodeMappingJSON(raw, &stream); err != nil {
		return stream, err
	}
	var fields map[string]json.RawMessage
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &fields); err != nil {
		return stream, err
	}
	if err := mappingStartupRequired(fields, "observed_bytes", &stream.ObservedBytes); err != nil {
		return stream, err
	}
	if err := mappingStartupRequired(fields, "prefix_base64", &stream.PrefixBase64); err != nil {
		return stream, err
	}
	if err := mappingStartupRequired(fields, "prefix_truncated", &stream.PrefixTruncated); err != nil {
		return stream, err
	}
	if stream.ObservedBytes < 0 || len(stream.PrefixBase64) > base64.StdEncoding.EncodedLen(2048) {
		return stream, errors.New("inventory stream capture exceeds its bound")
	}
	prefix, err := base64.StdEncoding.Strict().DecodeString(stream.PrefixBase64)
	if err != nil {
		return stream, err
	}
	if base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(prefix) != stream.PrefixBase64 || int64(len(prefix)) != min(stream.ObservedBytes, 2048) || stream.PrefixTruncated != (stream.ObservedBytes > int64(len(prefix))) {
		return stream, errors.New("inventory stream prefix, observed count and truncation disagree")
	}
	return stream, nil
}

func mappingStartupObservedPair(length int, hash string, maximum int) (bool, error) {
	if length == 0 && hash == "" {
		return false, nil
	}
	if length <= 0 || length > maximum || len(hash) != 64 || strings.Trim(hash, "0123456789abcdef") != "" {
		return false, errors.New("inventory input or script facts are incomplete or invalid")
	}
	return true, nil
}

func validateMappingStartupAdmission(initialError string, raw json.RawMessage) (mappingCommandDiagnostic, error) {
	var diagnostic mappingCommandDiagnostic
	first, _, _ := strings.Cut(initialError, "\n")
	if first != context.DeadlineExceeded.Error() {
		return diagnostic, errors.New("original initial inventory did not fail first with its command deadline")
	}
	if err := decodeMappingJSON(raw, &diagnostic); err != nil {
		return diagnostic, err
	}
	var fields map[string]json.RawMessage
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &fields); err != nil {
		return diagnostic, err
	}
	for _, field := range []struct {
		name   string
		target any
	}{
		{"action", &diagnostic.Action}, {"action_truncated", &diagnostic.ActionTruncated},
		{"eof_requested", &diagnostic.EOFRequested}, {"cleanup_confirmed", &diagnostic.CleanupConfirmed},
		{"workers_started", &diagnostic.WorkersStarted}, {"workers_joined", &diagnostic.WorkersJoined},
		{"input_bytes", &diagnostic.InputBytes}, {"input_sha256", &diagnostic.InputSHA256},
		{"script_utf16_units", &diagnostic.ScriptUTF16Units}, {"script_utf16le_sha256", &diagnostic.ScriptSHA256},
	} {
		if err := mappingStartupRequired(fields, field.name, field.target); err != nil {
			return diagnostic, err
		}
	}
	if diagnostic.Action != "inventory" || diagnostic.ActionTruncated || diagnostic.EOFRequested ||
		!diagnostic.CleanupConfirmed || diagnostic.WorkersStarted < 0 || diagnostic.WorkersStarted > 3 || diagnostic.WorkersJoined != diagnostic.WorkersStarted {
		return diagnostic, errors.New("initial inventory timeout has an incompatible action, input policy or unsettled cleanup")
	}
	if _, err := mappingStartupObservedPair(diagnostic.InputBytes, diagnostic.InputSHA256, 4096); err != nil {
		return diagnostic, err
	}
	if _, err := mappingStartupObservedPair(diagnostic.ScriptUTF16Units, diagnostic.ScriptSHA256, int(^uint(0)>>1)); err != nil {
		return diagnostic, err
	}
	var err error
	if diagnostic.Stdout, err = validateMappingStartupCapture(fields["stdout_observed"]); err != nil {
		return diagnostic, err
	}
	if diagnostic.Stderr, err = validateMappingStartupCapture(fields["stderr_observed"]); err != nil {
		return diagnostic, err
	}
	return diagnostic, nil
}

func mappingStartupInventoryIntent(request []byte, script string) mappingStartupIntent {
	words := utf16.Encode([]rune(script))
	data := make([]byte, 2*len(words))
	for i, word := range words {
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(data[2*i:], word)
	}
	return mappingStartupIntent{len(request), fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256(request)), len(words), fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256(data))}
}

func compareMappingStartupIntent(diagnostic mappingCommandDiagnostic, intent mappingStartupIntent) error {
	input, err := mappingStartupObservedPair(diagnostic.InputBytes, diagnostic.InputSHA256, 4096)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	script, err := mappingStartupObservedPair(diagnostic.ScriptUTF16Units, diagnostic.ScriptSHA256, int(^uint(0)>>1))
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if input && (diagnostic.InputBytes != intent.InputBytes || diagnostic.InputSHA256 != intent.InputSHA256) ||
		script && (diagnostic.ScriptUTF16Units != intent.ScriptUTF16Units || diagnostic.ScriptSHA256 != intent.ScriptSHA256) {
		return errors.New("current inventory request or script differs from produced original facts")
	}
	return nil
}

func readMappingStartupFile(path string, limit int64) ([]byte, error) {
	if err := rejectPrivateReparsePath(path); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	file, err := os.Open(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	info, statErr := file.Stat()
	if statErr != nil || !info.Mode().IsRegular() || info.Size() > limit {
		return nil, errors.Join(statErr, errors.New("diagnostic input is not a bounded regular file"), file.Close())
	}
	data, readErr := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(file, limit+1))
	if len(data) > int(limit) {
		readErr = errors.Join(readErr, errors.New("diagnostic input exceeded its bound"))
	}
	return data, errors.Join(readErr, file.Close())
}

func validateMappingStartupIdentity(config mappingStartupConfig) error {
	if config.Format != 1 || config.RunID == "" || len(config.RunID) > 96 || strings.Trim(config.RunID, "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789_-") != "" ||
		len(config.SourceSHA) != 40 || strings.Trim(config.SourceSHA, "0123456789abcdef") != "" || len(config.FixtureNonce) != 64 || strings.Trim(config.FixtureNonce, "0123456789abcdef") != "" || config.OwnerSID == "" {
		return errors.New("invalid diagnostic identity")
	}
	return nil
}

func validateMappingStartupPrior(config mappingStartupConfig, prior map[string]any) error {
	if prior["run_id"] != config.RunID || prior["source_sha"] != config.SourceSHA || prior["fixture_nonce"] != config.FixtureNonce || prior["fixture_readiness"] != "failed" || prior["current_smb_cold_requested"] != true {
		return errors.New("prior cold receipt does not match diagnostic identity and failure")
	}
	return nil
}

func readMappingStartupConfig() (mappingStartupConfig, error) {
	var config mappingStartupConfig
	path := os.Getenv("RFS_MAPPING_STARTUP_CONFIG")
	data, err := readMappingStartupFile(path, 64<<10)
	if err != nil {
		return config, err
	}
	if err := decodeMappingJSON(data, &config); err != nil {
		return config, err
	}
	if err := validateMappingStartupIdentity(config); err != nil {
		return config, err
	}
	if filepath.Dir(path) != config.EvidenceDirectory || filepath.Base(config.PriorEvidenceDirectory) != "evidence" || filepath.Base(filepath.Dir(config.PriorEvidenceDirectory)) != config.RunID {
		return config, errors.New("diagnostic directories do not bind the configured run")
	}
	if config.NativeEvidenceDirectory != filepath.Join(config.EvidenceDirectory, "native-evidence") {
		return config, errors.New("native evidence directory is not the fixed direct child")
	}
	for _, directory := range []string{config.PriorEvidenceDirectory, config.EvidenceDirectory} {
		if err := rejectPrivateReparsePath(directory); err != nil {
			return config, err
		}
		info, err := os.Stat(directory)
		if err != nil {
			return config, err
		}
		if !info.IsDir() {
			return config, errors.New("diagnostic evidence path is not a directory")
		}
	}
	config.initial, err = validateMappingStartupAdmission(config.InitialInventoryError, config.InitialInventoryDiagnostic)
	if err != nil {
		return config, err
	}
	priorData, err := readMappingStartupFile(filepath.Join(config.PriorEvidenceDirectory, "receipt.json"), 64<<10)
	if err != nil {
		return config, err
	}
	var prior map[string]any
	if err := decodeMappingJSON(priorData, &prior); err != nil {
		return config, err
	}
	if err := validateMappingStartupPrior(config, prior); err != nil {
		return config, err
	}
	return config, nil
}

var errMappingStartupReceiptBound = errors.New("diagnostic receipt exceeds 1 MiB")

func encodeMappingStartupReceipt(receipt mappingStartupReceipt) ([]byte, error) {
	data, err := json.MarshalIndent(receipt, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if len(data)+1 > 1<<20 {
		return nil, errMappingStartupReceiptBound
	}
	return append(data, '\n'), nil
}

func writeMappingStartupReceipt(path string, receipt mappingStartupReceipt) error {
	data, err := encodeMappingStartupReceipt(receipt)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if filepath.Base(path) != "mapping-startup.json" {
		return errors.New("native evidence filename is not fixed")
	}
	return writePrivateEvidence(filepath.Dir(path), "mapping-startup.json", data)
}

func inspectMappingStartupImage(path string) (result mappingStartupImageReceipt) {
	result.Path = path
	var inspectionErr error
	defer func() {
		if inspectionErr != nil {
			result.Error, _ = mappingDiagnosticText(inspectionErr.Error(), 1024)
		}
	}()
	if inspectionErr = rejectPrivateReparsePath(path); inspectionErr != nil {
		return result
	}
	file, err := os.Open(path)
	if err != nil {
		inspectionErr = err
		return result
	}
	defer func() { inspectionErr = errors.Join(inspectionErr, file.Close()) }()
	before, err := file.Stat()
	if err != nil {
		inspectionErr = err
		return result
	}
	if !before.Mode().IsRegular() || before.Size() > 64<<20 {
		inspectionErr = errors.New("post-attempt image is not a regular file within 64 MiB")
		return result
	}
	result.Size = before.Size()
	image, err := pe.NewFile(file)
	if err != nil {
		inspectionErr = err
		return result
	}
	result.Machine = image.Machine
	digest := sha256.New()
	count, err := io.Copy(digest, io.LimitReader(file, (64<<20)+1))
	if err != nil {
		inspectionErr = err
		return result
	}
	after, err := file.Stat()
	if err != nil {
		inspectionErr = err
		return result
	}
	if count != before.Size() || before.Size() != after.Size() || before.ModTime() != after.ModTime() {
		inspectionErr = errors.New("post-attempt image changed during inspection")
		return result
	}
	result.SHA256 = fmt.Sprintf("%x", digest.Sum(nil))
	return result
}

func TestMappingPowerShellStartupDiagnostic(t *testing.T) {
	assertMappingStartupAdmission(t)
	assertMappingStartupIntent(t)
	assertMappingStartupIdentity(t)
	assertMappingStartupEnvironment(t)
	assertMappingStartupReceiptBounds(t)
	assertMappingStartupUtilityPreparation(t)
	config, err := readMappingStartupConfig()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	receipt := mappingStartupReceipt{
		Format: 1, RunID: config.RunID, SourceSHA: config.SourceSHA, FixtureNonce: config.FixtureNonce,
		Status: "failed", Aborted: true, CleanupConfirmed: true,
		TimingContext:           "after original cold failure and VM cleanup; sequential cells may be warmed by earlier launches",
		ImageFactsContext:       "post-attempt on-disk bytes; not proof of bytes loaded by each process",
		EnvironmentFactsContext: "parent inherited values and configured child input at diagnostic Start only; original cold environment was not recorded; PowerShell may reconstruct runtime paths",
		PriorEvidenceDirectory:  config.PriorEvidenceDirectory, InitialInventoryDiagnostic: config.InitialInventoryDiagnostic,
		InitialInventoryError: config.InitialInventoryError,
		OriginalInputObserved: config.initial.InputBytes > 0, OriginalScriptObserved: config.initial.ScriptUTF16Units > 0,
		Cells: []mappingStartupCellReceipt{}, Images: []mappingStartupImageReceipt{},
	}
	work := ""
	defer func() {
		if receipt.CleanupConfirmed {
			seen := make(map[string]bool)
			for _, cell := range receipt.Cells {
				launch := cell.Diagnostic.Launch
				if launch == nil || launch.ActualImage == "" || seen[launch.ActualImage] {
					continue
				}
				seen[launch.ActualImage] = true
				image := inspectMappingStartupImage(launch.ActualImage)
				receipt.Images = append(receipt.Images, image)
				if image.Error != "" {
					t.Errorf("post-attempt executable inspection: %s", image.Error)
				}
			}
			if work != "" {
				if err := os.Remove(work); err != nil {
					t.Errorf("remove owned diagnostic working directory: %v", err)
				}
			}
		}
		if !t.Failed() && !receipt.Aborted && len(receipt.Cells) == len(mappingStartupPlan()) {
			receipt.Status = "passed"
		}
		if err := writeMappingStartupReceipt(filepath.Join(config.NativeEvidenceDirectory, "mapping-startup.json"), receipt); err != nil {
			t.Errorf("write diagnostic receipt: %v", err)
		}
	}()
	owner, err := currentMappingOwner()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if owner.SID != config.OwnerSID {
		t.Fatal("current primary SID differs from the original cold owner")
	}
	work = filepath.Join(config.EvidenceDirectory, "work")
	if err := createPrivateDirectory(work); err != nil {
		work = ""
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	backend, err := newNativeMappingBackend(options{StateFile: filepath.Join(work, "unused-state.json")})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	native := backend.(*nativeMappingBackend)
	if native.owner != owner {
		t.Fatal("mapping owner changed during diagnostic preparation")
	}
	request := mappingCommandRequest{Action: "inventory", Module: native.module, OwnerSID: owner.SID}
	requestBytes, err := json.Marshal(request)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	requestBytes = append(requestBytes, '\n')
	intent := mappingStartupInventoryIntent(requestBytes, mappingPowerShell)
	receipt.DiagnosticInventoryIntent = &intent
	if err := compareMappingStartupIntent(config.initial, intent); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	processCreations := 0
	receipt.Aborted = walkMappingStartupCells(func(ordinal int, cell mappingStartupCell) bool {
		clean := false
		t.Run(cell.Name, func(t *testing.T) {
			execution := mappingExecution{Diagnostic: mappingCommandDiagnostic{CleanupConfirmed: true}}
			var preparation *mappingStartupUtilityPreparation
			observed := &mappingStartupObservedPlatform{delegate: native.host, lookup: os.LookupEnv}
			before, cellErr := currentMappingOwner()
			if cellErr == nil && before != owner {
				cellErr = errors.New("mapping owner changed before diagnostic cell")
			}
			if cellErr == nil {
				cellErr = requireMappingJob()
			}
			if cellErr == nil {
				ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 4*time.Second)
				cell, preparation, cellErr = prepareMappingStartupCell(ctx, cell, native.moduleRoot, native.executable, mappingStartupUtilityOps{
					CheckPath: rejectPrivateReparsePath,
					Open: func(path string) (mappingStartupUtilityFile, error) {
						file, err := os.Open(path)
						if err != nil {
							return nil, err
						}
						return file, nil
					},
					CommandLine: windows.ComposeCommandLine,
				})
				attempted := cellErr == nil
				if attempted {
					execution, cellErr = executeMappingPowerShell(ctx, observed, native.executable, work, native.moduleRoot, request, cell.Script, cell.CloseInput)
				} else if preparation != nil {
					execution.Diagnostic.CleanupConfirmed = preparation.CleanupConfirmed
				}
				cancel()
				if attempted {
					cellErr = errors.Join(cellErr, compareMappingStartupIntent(execution.Diagnostic, mappingStartupInventoryIntent(requestBytes, cell.Script)))
					prefix, prefixErr := base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString(execution.Diagnostic.Stderr.PrefixBase64)
					if prefixErr != nil || !strings.HasPrefix(string(prefix), cell.Entry+"\r\n") && !strings.HasPrefix(string(prefix), cell.Entry+"\n") {
						cellErr = errors.Join(cellErr, prefixErr, errors.New("cell entry marker was not captured"))
					}
					cellErr = errors.Join(cellErr, validateMappingStartupResult(cell, execution.Stdout, request))
					if execution.Diagnostic.WorkersStarted != 3 || execution.Diagnostic.WorkersJoined != 3 {
						cellErr = errors.Join(cellErr, errors.New("cell did not start and join exactly three I/O workers"))
					}
					if cell.CloseInput && !execution.Diagnostic.EOFCompleted {
						cellErr = errors.Join(cellErr, errors.New("EOF cell did not complete its owned input"))
					}
				}
				clean = execution.Diagnostic.CleanupConfirmed
				after, ownerErr := currentMappingOwner()
				if ownerErr == nil && after != owner {
					ownerErr = errors.New("mapping owner changed during diagnostic cell")
				}
				cellErr = errors.Join(cellErr, ownerErr)
				if ownerErr != nil {
					clean = false
				}
			}
			entry := mappingStartupCellReceipt{Name: cell.Name, Kind: cell.Kind, Ordinal: ordinal, PriorDiagnosticProcessCreations: processCreations, Status: "passed", Diagnostic: execution.Diagnostic, ParentEnvironment: observed.parentEnvironment, ChildEnvironment: observed.childEnvironment, UtilityPreparation: preparation}
			if execution.Diagnostic.PID != nil || execution.Diagnostic.Launch != nil && execution.Diagnostic.Launch.PID != nil {
				processCreations++
			}
			if cellErr != nil {
				entry.Status = "failed"
				entry.Error, entry.ErrorTruncated = mappingDiagnosticText(cellErr.Error(), 4096)
				t.Errorf("diagnostic cell failed: %v", cellErr)
			}
			receipt.CleanupConfirmed = receipt.CleanupConfirmed && execution.Diagnostic.CleanupConfirmed
			receipt.Cells = append(receipt.Cells, entry)
			data, err := json.Marshal(entry)
			if err != nil {
				clean = false
				t.Error(err)
			} else {
				t.Logf("mapping startup cell: %s", data)
			}
		})
		return clean
	})
	if receipt.Aborted {
		t.Error("diagnostic aborted before later cells could be admitted")
	}
}

func mappingStartupAssertionJSON(t *testing.T, value any) json.RawMessage {
	t.Helper()
	data, err := json.Marshal(value)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return data
}

func mappingStartupAssertionDiagnostic() mappingCommandDiagnostic {
	intent := mappingStartupInventoryIntent([]byte("{\"action\":\"inventory\"}\n"), mappingPowerShell)
	return mappingCommandDiagnostic{
		Action: "inventory", InputBytes: intent.InputBytes, InputSHA256: intent.InputSHA256,
		ScriptUTF16Units: intent.ScriptUTF16Units, ScriptSHA256: intent.ScriptSHA256,
		WriteStarted: true, WriteReturned: true, WriteComplete: true, WriteBytes: intent.InputBytes,
		WorkersStarted: 3, WorkersJoined: 3, CleanupAttempted: true, CleanupConfirmed: true,
	}
}

func mappingStartupAssertionCapture(data []byte, observed int64) mappingStreamDiagnostic {
	return mappingStreamDiagnostic{ObservedBytes: observed, PrefixBase64: base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(data), PrefixTruncated: observed > int64(len(data))}
}

func assertMappingStartupAdmission(t *testing.T) {
	t.Helper()
	initialError := "context deadline exceeded\noriginal child and cleanup details"
	markers := []string{"entry", "before-readline", "after-readline", "before-json", "after-json", "before-owner", "after-owner", "before-import", "after-import", "before-inventory", "after-inventory", "after-result"}
	for n := 0; n <= len(markers); n++ {
		{
			var prefix string
			for _, marker := range markers[:n] {
				if !strings.Contains(mappingPowerShell, "'RFS-MAPPING/1 "+marker+"'") {
					t.Fatal("asserted inventory marker is absent from the source script")
				}
				prefix += "RFS-MAPPING/1 " + marker + "\r\n"
			}
			diagnostic := mappingStartupAssertionDiagnostic()
			diagnostic.Stderr = mappingStartupAssertionCapture([]byte(prefix), int64(len(prefix)))
			if _, err := validateMappingStartupAdmission(initialError, mappingStartupAssertionJSON(t, diagnostic)); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
		}
	}
	for _, test := range []struct {
		name   string
		prefix []byte
		count  int64
	}{
		{"partial-line", []byte("RFS-MAPPING/1 before-j"), 22},
		{"non-marker", []byte("not a stage\x00\xff"), 13},
		{"truncated", []byte(strings.Repeat("x", 2048)), 4097},
		{"max-counter", []byte(strings.Repeat("x", 2048)), int64(^uint64(0) >> 1)},
	} {
		{
			diagnostic := mappingStartupAssertionDiagnostic()
			diagnostic.Stdout = mappingStartupAssertionCapture(test.prefix, test.count)
			diagnostic.Stderr = diagnostic.Stdout
			if _, err := validateMappingStartupAdmission(initialError, mappingStartupAssertionJSON(t, diagnostic)); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
		}
	}
	{
		diagnostic := mappingCommandDiagnostic{Action: "inventory", CleanupConfirmed: true}
		got, err := validateMappingStartupAdmission(initialError, mappingStartupAssertionJSON(t, diagnostic))
		if err != nil || got.PID != nil || got.Launch != nil || got.InputBytes != 0 || got.InputSHA256 != "" || got.ScriptUTF16Units != 0 || got.ScriptSHA256 != "" {
			t.Fatalf("unavailable facts were rejected or invented: %+v %v", got, err)
		}
	}
	for _, first := range []string{"", "context canceled", "failure\ncontext deadline exceeded", " context deadline exceeded", "context deadline exceeded\r"} {
		if _, err := validateMappingStartupAdmission(first, mappingStartupAssertionJSON(t, mappingStartupAssertionDiagnostic())); err == nil {
			t.Fatalf("non-timeout first line admitted: %q", first)
		}
	}
	for _, test := range []struct {
		name, field string
		value       any
		remove      bool
	}{
		{"action", "action", "create", false}, {"truncated-action", "action_truncated", true, false},
		{"EOF", "eof_requested", true, false}, {"cleanup", "cleanup_confirmed", false, false},
		{"missing-cleanup", "cleanup_confirmed", nil, true}, {"null-cleanup", "cleanup_confirmed", nil, false},
		{"joined", "workers_joined", 2, false}, {"workers-overbound", "workers_started", 4, false},
		{"boolean-workers", "workers_started", true, false}, {"null-workers", "workers_started", nil, false},
		{"missing-input", "input_bytes", nil, true}, {"boolean-input", "input_bytes", true, false},
		{"oversize-input", "input_bytes", 4097, false}, {"missing-input-hash", "input_sha256", nil, true},
		{"incomplete-input", "input_sha256", "", false}, {"incomplete-script", "script_utf16_units", 0, false},
		{"uppercase-hash", "script_utf16le_sha256", strings.Repeat("A", 64), false},
		{"overflow-script", "script_utf16_units", json.Number("9223372036854775808"), false},
	} {
		{
			var fields map[string]any
			if err := json.Unmarshal(mappingStartupAssertionJSON(t, mappingStartupAssertionDiagnostic()), &fields); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if test.remove {
				delete(fields, test.field)
			} else {
				fields[test.field] = test.value
			}
			if _, err := validateMappingStartupAdmission(initialError, mappingStartupAssertionJSON(t, fields)); err == nil {
				t.Fatal("malformed inventory facts admitted")
			}
		}
	}
	for _, test := range []struct {
		name, field string
		value       any
		remove      bool
	}{
		{"negative-count", "observed_bytes", -1, false}, {"boolean-count", "observed_bytes", true, false},
		{"null-count", "observed_bytes", nil, false}, {"missing-count", "observed_bytes", nil, true},
		{"fractional-count", "observed_bytes", 1.5, false}, {"overflow-count", "observed_bytes", json.Number("9223372036854775808"), false},
		{"invalid-base64", "prefix_base64", "!!!!", false}, {"noncanonical-pad", "prefix_base64", "Zh==", false},
		{"base64-newline", "prefix_base64", "Zg==\n", false}, {"missing-padding", "prefix_base64", "Zg", false},
		{"missing-prefix", "prefix_base64", nil, true}, {"oversize-prefix", "prefix_base64", base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(make([]byte, 2049)), false},
		{"count-prefix-mismatch", "observed_bytes", 2, false}, {"truncation-mismatch", "prefix_truncated", true, false},
		{"integer-truncation", "prefix_truncated", 0, false}, {"null-truncation", "prefix_truncated", nil, false},
		{"missing-truncation", "prefix_truncated", nil, true},
	} {
		{
			for _, name := range []string{"stdout_observed", "stderr_observed"} {
				var fields map[string]any
				if err := json.Unmarshal(mappingStartupAssertionJSON(t, mappingStartupAssertionDiagnostic()), &fields); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				stream := map[string]any{"observed_bytes": 1, "prefix_base64": "Zg==", "prefix_truncated": false}
				if test.remove {
					delete(stream, test.field)
				} else {
					stream[test.field] = test.value
				}
				fields[name] = stream
				if _, err := validateMappingStartupAdmission(initialError, mappingStartupAssertionJSON(t, fields)); err == nil {
					t.Fatalf("malformed %s admitted", name)
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

func assertMappingStartupIntent(t *testing.T) {
	t.Helper()
	request := []byte("{\"action\":\"inventory\"}\n")
	intent := mappingStartupInventoryIntent(request, mappingPowerShell)
	diagnostic := mappingStartupAssertionDiagnostic()
	if err := compareMappingStartupIntent(diagnostic, intent); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, change := range []func(*mappingCommandDiagnostic){
		func(d *mappingCommandDiagnostic) { d.InputBytes++ },
		func(d *mappingCommandDiagnostic) { d.InputSHA256 = strings.Repeat("0", 64) },
		func(d *mappingCommandDiagnostic) { d.ScriptUTF16Units++ },
		func(d *mappingCommandDiagnostic) { d.ScriptSHA256 = strings.Repeat("0", 64) },
	} {
		other := diagnostic
		change(&other)
		if err := compareMappingStartupIntent(other, intent); err == nil {
			t.Fatal("produced request/script mismatch admitted")
		}
	}
	for _, unavailable := range []string{"input", "script", "both"} {
		other := diagnostic
		if unavailable != "script" {
			other.InputBytes, other.InputSHA256 = 0, ""
		}
		if unavailable != "input" {
			other.ScriptUTF16Units, other.ScriptSHA256 = 0, ""
		}
		before := other
		if err := compareMappingStartupIntent(other, intent); err != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(before, other) {
			t.Fatalf("unavailable %s was rejected or replaced: %v", unavailable, err)
		}
	}
	unicodeIntent := mappingStartupInventoryIntent([]byte("x\n"), "𝄞")
	if unicodeIntent.ScriptUTF16Units != 2 || unicodeIntent.ScriptSHA256 != fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256([]byte{0x34, 0xd8, 0x1e, 0xdd})) {
		t.Fatal("script comparison did not use exact UTF-16LE code units")
	}
}

func assertMappingStartupIdentity(t *testing.T) {
	t.Helper()
	config := mappingStartupConfig{Format: 1, RunID: "run-1", SourceSHA: strings.Repeat("a", 40), FixtureNonce: strings.Repeat("b", 64), OwnerSID: "owner"}
	prior := map[string]any{"run_id": config.RunID, "source_sha": config.SourceSHA, "fixture_nonce": config.FixtureNonce, "fixture_readiness": "failed", "current_smb_cold_requested": true}
	if err := validateMappingStartupIdentity(config); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := validateMappingStartupPrior(config, prior); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, change := range []func(*mappingStartupConfig){
		func(c *mappingStartupConfig) { c.Format = 0 }, func(c *mappingStartupConfig) { c.RunID = "../run" },
		func(c *mappingStartupConfig) { c.RunID = "" }, func(c *mappingStartupConfig) { c.RunID = strings.Repeat("x", 97) },
		func(c *mappingStartupConfig) { c.SourceSHA = strings.Repeat("A", 40) }, func(c *mappingStartupConfig) { c.SourceSHA = "" },
		func(c *mappingStartupConfig) { c.FixtureNonce = strings.Repeat("b", 63) }, func(c *mappingStartupConfig) { c.FixtureNonce = strings.Repeat("X", 64) },
		func(c *mappingStartupConfig) { c.OwnerSID = "" },
	} {
		other := config
		change(&other)
		if err := validateMappingStartupIdentity(other); err == nil {
			t.Fatal("malformed diagnostic identity admitted")
		}
	}
	for _, name := range []string{"run_id", "source_sha", "fixture_nonce", "fixture_readiness", "current_smb_cold_requested"} {
		other := make(map[string]any, len(prior))
		for key, value := range prior {
			other[key] = value
		}
		other[name] = "foreign"
		if err := validateMappingStartupPrior(config, other); err == nil {
			t.Fatalf("foreign %s admitted", name)
		}
		delete(other, name)
		if err := validateMappingStartupPrior(config, other); err == nil {
			t.Fatalf("missing %s admitted", name)
		}
	}
}

type mappingStartupAssertionPlatform struct {
	preflight func() (map[string]any, error)
	start     func(string, []string, string, []string) (child, error)
}

func (p mappingStartupAssertionPlatform) Preflight() (map[string]any, error) { return p.preflight() }
func (p mappingStartupAssertionPlatform) StartWithEnvironment(executable string, args []string, directory string, environment []string) (child, error) {
	return p.start(executable, args, directory, environment)
}

type mappingStartupAssertionChild struct{ child }

func assertMappingStartupEnvironment(t *testing.T) {
	t.Helper()
	values := map[string]string{"PSModulePath": strings.Repeat("界", 2000), "PSModuleAnalysisCachePath": "", "unrelated": "must-not-be-read"}
	var looked []string
	lookup := func(name string) (string, bool) {
		looked = append(looked, name)
		value, present := values[name]
		return value, present
	}
	observations := observeMappingStartupEnvironment(lookup)
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(looked, []string{"PSModulePath", "WinPSModulePath", "PSModuleAnalysisCachePath"}) || len(observations) != 3 {
		t.Fatal("environment observation exceeded its allowlist")
	}
	large, absent, empty := observations[0], observations[1], observations[2]
	if !large.Present || large.Value == nil || large.Value.ObservedBytes != 6000 || !large.Value.Truncated || large.Value.SHA256 != fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256([]byte(values["PSModulePath"]))) {
		t.Fatal("large environment value lost its observed byte/hash facts")
	}
	prefix, err := base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString(large.Value.PrefixBase64)
	if err != nil || len(prefix) != 4096 || string(prefix) != values["PSModulePath"][:4096] {
		t.Fatal("environment prefix exceeded or changed its byte bound")
	}
	if absent.Present || absent.Value != nil || !empty.Present || empty.Value == nil || empty.Value.ObservedBytes != 0 || empty.Value.PrefixBase64 != "" || empty.Value.Truncated || empty.Value.SHA256 != fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256(nil)) {
		t.Fatal("absent and present-empty environment values were conflated")
	}
	if values["unrelated"] != "must-not-be-read" || values["PSModuleAnalysisCachePath"] != "" {
		t.Fatal("observation changed environment data")
	}
	for _, startFailure := range []error{nil, errors.New("delegated start failed")} {
		looked = nil
		values["PSModulePath"], values["PSModuleAnalysisCachePath"] = "before-start", "parent-cache"
		provided := []string{"PSModulePath=verified-root", "PSModuleAnalysisCachePath=NUL", "UNRELATED=preserved", "=C:=C:\\work"}
		beforeProvided := append([]string(nil), provided...)
		wantChild := &mappingStartupAssertionChild{}
		starts, preflights := 0, 0
		preflightFailure := errors.New("preflight detail")
		var adapter *mappingStartupObservedPlatform
		delegate := mappingStartupAssertionPlatform{
			preflight: func() (map[string]any, error) { preflights++; return map[string]any{"fact": "same"}, preflightFailure },
			start: func(executable string, args []string, directory string, environment []string) (child, error) {
				starts++
				if executable != "same.exe" || directory != "same-directory" || !reflect.DeepEqual(args, []string{"same-arg"}) || !reflect.DeepEqual(environment, beforeProvided) {
					t.Fatal("adapter changed launch inputs")
				}
				if len(adapter.parentEnvironment) != 3 || len(adapter.childEnvironment) != 3 || adapter.childEnvironment[2].Value == nil || adapter.childEnvironment[2].Value.SHA256 != fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256([]byte("NUL"))) || adapter.parentEnvironment[2].Value.SHA256 != fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256([]byte("parent-cache"))) {
					t.Fatal("parent and configured child environments were not observed separately before delegation")
				}
				return wantChild, startFailure
			},
		}
		adapter = &mappingStartupObservedPlatform{delegate: delegate, lookup: lookup}
		facts, preflightErr := adapter.Preflight()
		if !reflect.DeepEqual(facts, map[string]any{"fact": "same"}) || preflightErr != preflightFailure || preflights != 1 || adapter.parentEnvironment != nil || adapter.childEnvironment != nil || len(looked) != 0 {
			t.Fatal("preflight changed results or invented Start observations")
		}
		values["PSModulePath"] = "at-start"
		gotChild, gotErr := adapter.StartWithEnvironment("same.exe", []string{"same-arg"}, "same-directory", provided)
		if starts != 1 || gotChild != wantChild || gotErr != startFailure || len(looked) != 3 {
			t.Fatal("adapter changed the delegated child/error or call count")
		}
		if adapter.parentEnvironment[0].Value.SHA256 != fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256([]byte("at-start"))) || adapter.childEnvironment[0].Value.SHA256 != fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256([]byte("verified-root"))) || values["PSModulePath"] != "at-start" || values["PSModuleAnalysisCachePath"] != "parent-cache" || !reflect.DeepEqual(provided, beforeProvided) {
			t.Fatal("adapter observed early or changed input values")
		}
		if _, present := values["WinPSModulePath"]; present || adapter.parentEnvironment[1].Present || adapter.childEnvironment[1].Present {
			t.Fatal("adapter manufactured WinPSModulePath")
		}
	}
}

type mappingStartupUtilityAssertionInfo struct {
	size int64
	mode os.FileMode
}

func (i mappingStartupUtilityAssertionInfo) Name() string       { return "Microsoft.PowerShell.Utility.psd1" }
func (i mappingStartupUtilityAssertionInfo) Size() int64        { return i.size }
func (i mappingStartupUtilityAssertionInfo) Mode() os.FileMode  { return i.mode }
func (i mappingStartupUtilityAssertionInfo) ModTime() time.Time { return time.Time{} }
func (i mappingStartupUtilityAssertionInfo) IsDir() bool        { return i.mode.IsDir() }
func (i mappingStartupUtilityAssertionInfo) Sys() any           { return nil }

type mappingStartupUtilityAssertionFile struct {
	reader            io.Reader
	info              os.FileInfo
	statErr, closeErr error
	closes            int
}

func (f *mappingStartupUtilityAssertionFile) Read(data []byte) (int, error) {
	return f.reader.Read(data)
}
func (f *mappingStartupUtilityAssertionFile) Stat() (os.FileInfo, error) { return f.info, f.statErr }
func (f *mappingStartupUtilityAssertionFile) Close() error               { f.closes++; return f.closeErr }

type mappingStartupUtilityAssertionReader func([]byte) (int, error)

func (r mappingStartupUtilityAssertionReader) Read(data []byte) (int, error) { return r(data) }

func assertMappingStartupUtilityPreparation(t *testing.T) {
	t.Helper()
	moduleRoot := "/fixture/modules"
	if filepath.Separator == '\\' {
		moduleRoot = `C:\fixture\modules`
	}
	executable := filepath.Join(moduleRoot, "..", "powershell.exe")
	wantPath := filepath.Join(moduleRoot, "Microsoft.PowerShell.Utility", "Microsoft.PowerShell.Utility.psd1")
	data := "verified manifest bytes"
	newFile := func() *mappingStartupUtilityAssertionFile {
		return &mappingStartupUtilityAssertionFile{reader: strings.NewReader(data), info: mappingStartupUtilityAssertionInfo{size: int64(len(data))}}
	}
	checks, opens, commands := 0, 0, 0
	file := newFile()
	ops := mappingStartupUtilityOps{
		CheckPath: func(path string) error {
			checks++
			if path != wantPath {
				t.Fatal("unexpected Utility path")
			}
			return nil
		},
		Open: func(path string) (mappingStartupUtilityFile, error) {
			opens++
			if path != wantPath {
				t.Fatal("unexpected Utility open")
			}
			return file, nil
		},
		CommandLine: func(args []string) string {
			commands++
			if len(args) != 8 || args[0] != executable || !reflect.DeepEqual(args[1:7], []string{"-NoLogo", "-NoProfile", "-NonInteractive", "-ExecutionPolicy", "Bypass", "-EncodedCommand"}) {
				t.Fatal("Utility command arguments changed")
			}
			encoded, err := base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString(args[7])
			if err != nil || len(encoded)%2 != 0 {
				t.Fatal("Utility command is not UTF16LE base64")
			}
			words := make([]uint16, len(encoded)/2)
			for index := range words {
				words[index] = binary.LittleEndian.Uint16(encoded[index*2:])
			}
			want, err := mappingStartupImportScript(wantPath)
			if err != nil || string(utf16.Decode(words)) != want {
				t.Fatal("Utility command is not the prepared script")
			}
			return strings.Join(args, " ")
		},
	}
	plan := mappingStartupPlan()
	for _, cell := range plan[:5] {
		got, facts, err := prepareMappingStartupCell(context.Background(), cell, moduleRoot, executable, ops)
		if err != nil || facts != nil || got != cell || checks != 0 || opens != 0 || commands != 0 {
			t.Fatal("Utility preparation ran before the sixth cell")
		}
	}
	prepared, facts, err := prepareMappingStartupCell(context.Background(), plan[5], moduleRoot, executable, ops)
	if err != nil || facts == nil || prepared.Script == "" || checks != 1 || opens != 1 || commands != 1 || file.closes != 1 || !facts.CleanupConfirmed || facts.Path != wantPath || facts.Size == nil || *facts.Size != int64(len(data)) || facts.ReadBytes != len(data) || facts.SHA256 != fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256([]byte(data))) {
		t.Fatalf("late Utility preparation lost its checked facts: %+v %v", facts, err)
	}
	if _, _, err := prepareMappingStartupCell(context.Background(), prepared, moduleRoot, executable, ops); err == nil || opens != 1 {
		t.Fatal("prebuilt Utility script was accepted")
	}
	pathError, openError, statError, readError, closeError := errors.New("path-check"), errors.New("open"), errors.New("stat"), errors.New("read"), errors.New("close")
	for _, test := range []struct {
		name       string
		configure  func(*mappingStartupUtilityOps, *mappingStartupUtilityAssertionFile)
		want       []error
		wantClosed int
		clean      bool
	}{
		{"path", func(o *mappingStartupUtilityOps, f *mappingStartupUtilityAssertionFile) {
			o.CheckPath = func(string) error { return pathError }
		}, []error{pathError}, 0, true},
		{"open", func(o *mappingStartupUtilityOps, f *mappingStartupUtilityAssertionFile) {
			o.Open = func(string) (mappingStartupUtilityFile, error) { return nil, openError }
		}, []error{openError}, 0, true},
		{"open-with-handle", func(o *mappingStartupUtilityOps, f *mappingStartupUtilityAssertionFile) {
			o.Open = func(string) (mappingStartupUtilityFile, error) { return f, openError }
			f.closeErr = closeError
		}, []error{openError, closeError}, 1, false},
		{"stat", func(o *mappingStartupUtilityOps, f *mappingStartupUtilityAssertionFile) { f.statErr = statError }, []error{statError}, 1, true},
		{"read-close", func(o *mappingStartupUtilityOps, f *mappingStartupUtilityAssertionFile) {
			f.reader = mappingStartupUtilityAssertionReader(func([]byte) (int, error) { return 0, readError })
			f.closeErr = closeError
		}, []error{readError, closeError}, 1, false},
		{"close", func(o *mappingStartupUtilityOps, f *mappingStartupUtilityAssertionFile) { f.closeErr = closeError }, []error{closeError}, 1, false},
		{"directory", func(o *mappingStartupUtilityOps, f *mappingStartupUtilityAssertionFile) {
			f.info = mappingStartupUtilityAssertionInfo{mode: os.ModeDir}
		}, nil, 1, true},
		{"oversized-stat", func(o *mappingStartupUtilityOps, f *mappingStartupUtilityAssertionFile) {
			f.info = mappingStartupUtilityAssertionInfo{size: mappingByteLimit + 1}
		}, nil, 1, true},
		{"oversized-read", func(o *mappingStartupUtilityOps, f *mappingStartupUtilityAssertionFile) {
			f.reader = strings.NewReader(strings.Repeat("x", mappingByteLimit+1))
		}, nil, 1, true},
		{"size-changed", func(o *mappingStartupUtilityOps, f *mappingStartupUtilityAssertionFile) {
			f.info = mappingStartupUtilityAssertionInfo{size: 1}
		}, nil, 1, true},
		{"commandline", func(o *mappingStartupUtilityOps, f *mappingStartupUtilityAssertionFile) {
			o.CommandLine = func([]string) string { return strings.Repeat("x", 32767) }
		}, nil, 1, true},
		{"commandline-NUL", func(o *mappingStartupUtilityOps, f *mappingStartupUtilityAssertionFile) {
			o.CommandLine = func([]string) string { return "bad\x00command" }
		}, nil, 1, true},
	} {
		file := newFile()
		local := ops
		local.Open = func(string) (mappingStartupUtilityFile, error) { return file, nil }
		test.configure(&local, file)
		script, facts, err := prepareMappingStartupUtility(context.Background(), moduleRoot, executable, local)
		if err == nil || script != "" || facts.CleanupConfirmed != test.clean || file.closes != test.wantClosed {
			t.Fatalf("%s hid preparation/cleanup failure: %+v %v", test.name, facts, err)
		}
		for _, cause := range test.want {
			if !errors.Is(err, cause) {
				t.Fatalf("%s lost original cause %v: %v", test.name, cause, err)
			}
		}
	}
	{
		ctx, cancel := context.WithDeadline(context.Background(), time.Now().Add(-time.Second))
		defer cancel()
		beforeChecks := checks
		if script, facts, err := prepareMappingStartupUtility(ctx, moduleRoot, executable, ops); script != "" || !errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) || !facts.CleanupConfirmed || checks != beforeChecks {
			t.Fatal("expired original deadline admitted preparation")
		}
	}
	{
		ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
		defer cancel()
		local := ops
		local.CheckPath = func(string) error { cancel(); return nil }
		local.Open = func(string) (mappingStartupUtilityFile, error) {
			t.Fatal("canceled preparation opened a file")
			return nil, nil
		}
		if script, facts, err := prepareMappingStartupUtility(ctx, moduleRoot, executable, local); script != "" || !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) || !facts.CleanupConfirmed {
			t.Fatal("path check restarted the supplied context")
		}
	}
	{
		ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
		defer cancel()
		local := ops
		file := newFile()
		local.Open = func(string) (mappingStartupUtilityFile, error) { return file, nil }
		local.CommandLine = func([]string) string { cancel(); return "bounded" }
		if script, facts, err := prepareMappingStartupUtility(ctx, moduleRoot, executable, local); script != "" || !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) || !facts.CleanupConfirmed || file.closes != 1 {
			t.Fatal("late cancellation restarted the supplied context or leaked the file")
		}
	}
}

func assertMappingStartupReceiptBounds(t *testing.T) {
	t.Helper()
	diagnostic := mappingStartupAssertionDiagnostic()
	diagnostic.Stdout = mappingStartupAssertionCapture([]byte(strings.Repeat("o", 2048)), 4096)
	diagnostic.Stderr = mappingStartupAssertionCapture([]byte(strings.Repeat("e", 2048)), 4096)
	diagnostic.WriteError, diagnostic.EOFError, diagnostic.CleanupError = strings.Repeat("w", 512), strings.Repeat("f", 512), strings.Repeat("c", 512)
	processError := strings.Repeat("p", 512)
	diagnostic.PreCleanupResult = &processError
	stage := &windowsLaunchCall{Returned: true, Error: strings.Repeat("s", 512)}
	diagnostic.Launch = &windowsLaunchFacts{RequestedImage: strings.Repeat("r", 1024), ActualImage: strings.Repeat("a", 1024), CreateProcess: stage, AssignJob: stage, QueryImage: stage, QueryMachine: stage, ResumeThread: stage}
	originalDiagnostic := mappingStartupAssertionJSON(t, diagnostic)
	originalError := "context deadline exceeded\noriginal failure\nmapping command diagnostic: " + string(originalDiagnostic)
	receipt := mappingStartupReceipt{Format: 1, RunID: "run", SourceSHA: strings.Repeat("a", 40), FixtureNonce: strings.Repeat("b", 64), Status: "failed", InitialInventoryError: originalError, InitialInventoryDiagnostic: originalDiagnostic}
	for ordinal, cell := range mappingStartupPlan() {
		parentEnvironment := observeMappingStartupEnvironment(func(name string) (string, bool) { return strings.Repeat("p", 4097), true })
		childEnvironment := observeMappingStartupEnvironment(func(name string) (string, bool) { return strings.Repeat("c", 4097), true })
		receipt.Cells = append(receipt.Cells, mappingStartupCellReceipt{Name: cell.Name, Ordinal: ordinal + 1, Error: strings.Repeat("x", 4096), Diagnostic: diagnostic, ParentEnvironment: parentEnvironment, ChildEnvironment: childEnvironment})
	}
	encoded, err := encodeMappingStartupReceipt(receipt)
	if err != nil || len(encoded) > 1<<20 {
		t.Fatalf("maximal capture/environment prefixes did not fit: bytes=%d error=%v", len(encoded), err)
	}
	var restored mappingStartupReceipt
	if err := json.Unmarshal(encoded, &restored); err != nil || restored.InitialInventoryError != originalError {
		t.Fatalf("original inventory error was altered: %v", err)
	}
	if len(restored.Cells) != 6 || !reflect.DeepEqual(restored.Cells[0].ParentEnvironment, receipt.Cells[0].ParentEnvironment) || !reflect.DeepEqual(restored.Cells[0].ChildEnvironment, receipt.Cells[0].ChildEnvironment) {
		t.Fatal("dual environment observations were altered or dropped")
	}
	var original, roundTrip mappingCommandDiagnostic
	if err := json.Unmarshal(originalDiagnostic, &original); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(restored.InitialInventoryDiagnostic, &roundTrip); err != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(original, roundTrip) {
		t.Fatalf("original diagnostic was altered: %v", err)
	}
	exact := receipt
	exact.TimingContext = strings.Repeat("x", (1<<20)-len(encoded))
	boundary, err := encodeMappingStartupReceipt(exact)
	if err != nil || len(boundary) != 1<<20 || boundary[len(boundary)-1] != '\n' {
		t.Fatalf("receipt bound does not include its final LF: bytes=%d error=%v", len(boundary), err)
	}
	exact.TimingContext += "x"
	if data, err := encodeMappingStartupReceipt(exact); data != nil || !errors.Is(err, errMappingStartupReceiptBound) || exact.InitialInventoryError != originalError {
		t.Fatalf("over-cap receipt hid its failure or altered the original error: %v", err)
	}
	malformed := receipt
	malformed.InitialInventoryDiagnostic = json.RawMessage("{")
	_, err = encodeMappingStartupReceipt(malformed)
	var marshalError *json.MarshalerError
	if !errors.As(err, &marshalError) {
		t.Fatalf("serialization error chain was replaced: %v", err)
	}
	escaped := receipt
	escaped.Cells = append([]mappingStartupCellReceipt(nil), receipt.Cells...)
	escape := func(size int) string { return strings.Repeat("\x00", size) }
	for index := range escaped.Cells {
		entry := &escaped.Cells[index]
		entry.Error = escape(4096)
		entry.Diagnostic.WriteError, entry.Diagnostic.EOFError, entry.Diagnostic.CleanupError = escape(512), escape(512), escape(512)
		processError := escape(512)
		entry.Diagnostic.PreCleanupResult = &processError
		stage := &windowsLaunchCall{Returned: true, Error: escape(512)}
		entry.Diagnostic.Launch = &windowsLaunchFacts{RequestedImage: escape(1024), ActualImage: escape(1024), CreateProcess: stage, AssignJob: stage, QueryImage: stage, QueryMachine: stage, ResumeThread: stage}
	}
	if data, err := encodeMappingStartupReceipt(escaped); err != nil || len(data) > 1<<20 {
		t.Fatalf("six-cell escape-heavy fixture did not fit: bytes=%d error=%v", len(data), err)
	}
}
